behavior_changes: 6-bit MIPS opcodes -> dense 4-bit select; JR, SLLV/SRLV/SRAV dropped
shifts move x by y[3:0] (original shifted b by a)
LUI -> LDH (low byte of y into high byte)
carry/overflow/negative now defined (undriven in source); unused selects give 0 instead of high-Z
SLT/SLTU flag output removed; result carries the comparison
